name: Disable Controller Power Saving
description: Disables power-saving features on supported game controllers to reduce disconnects and sleep interruptions during gameplay.

description_i18n.en: Disables power-saving features on supported game controllers to reduce disconnects and sleep interruptions during gameplay.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert Energiesparfunktionen an unterstützten Gamepads, um Verbindungsabbrüche und Schlafunterbrechungen während des Spielens zu vermeiden.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive les fonctions d'économie d'énergie sur les manettes de jeu prises en charge pour réduire les déconnexions et interruptions pendant le jeu.

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the EnhancedPowerManagementEnabled registry value under HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Enum for detected controllers
